caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a small statue or figurine of a young boy, standing atop a rounded brown pedestal. The boy is dressed in period clothing, including a grey-blue coat with buttons, matching trousers, a vest, a white shirt, and a cravat or scarf around his neck. He is also wearing a large, grey top hat with a brown band. The boy's right hand is brought up to his chin, while his left arm hangs by his side. His facial features are detailed, and he is gazing confidently upward and to his left. The figure’s clothing and modeling are shaded and highlighted in tones of blue, grey, and brown, with some evidence of wear or patina suggesting an old or metallic surface. There are small handwritten markings, possibly a signature, in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: English Sailor
